name: knownAs.dev
description: Serves the knownAs.dev origin proof token, so this gateway can have a stable public name that survives tunnel restarts.

originTokens.label: Origin proof tokens
originTokens.help: The tokens knownAs.dev issued when a route was pointed at this gateway, one per route. Served at /.well-known/knownas-origin. The knownas skill sets these; they are not secrets.
